reviews.content:
I really liked Aether and Iron! Its a lovely decopunk game set in 30'NY.



Best artstyle I have ever played in a game, that alone deserves the thumbs up.



Hope to see more of this world in a future game!

As someone who grew up playing Left 4 Dead, I was excited to give this a shot as the successor to L4D as it's made by the same company. It absolutely has its weaknesses compared to its predecessor, but it's not a bad game at all. It's actually quite fun in its own merits. 



I am a fan of the larger mutation like the Ogre, Breaker, and the Abomination/Harbinger. Since the Tank was really the only boss you fought in L4D.



The game has strengths compared to L4D, but it has weaknesses.



The mutations having several variants make them a little difficult to keep up with, especially when there are little changes to differentiate them in appearance. This is why the special infected in L4D2 were so iconic, because they all look very different from one another. The B4B variants may have unique abilities, but if it weren't for the Cleaners shouting out what kind of variant it is, I'd have no clue.



Even though this game is no longer being updated, I still enjoy it for what it is. It feels way more balanced than from what I heard about in the beginning from siblings who played it at launch. And the downfall of this game was it was structured as a live-service game and without single player or VS mode.



So if anyone is wondering if they should give B4B a go? I absolutely think you'd like it if you're a L4D fan, as it's a familiar feel to what you're used to with some new mechanics. But don't buy it at full price, buy it here on IG. I got a copy for me for the DLC and a copy for a friend of mine for roughly $2, whilst using my credits.

Been playing with a couple of friends since launch and it's honestly one of the most tense shooters I've tried in years. The sound design is incredible — every "extractor" call makes you think twice about your route. Gunplay feels weighty and the maps have a lot of little details. I'd like a bit more variety in the enemy types, but overall it's well worth the price.

First i thought: Nice graphics, nice voice art, neat fighting mechanics.



Now: Every boss is unbalanced as hell and as fun as getting your junk ripped out.



- Teleporting enemies (not like the scy-fy, more like 40meter in 4 frames)



- heat seeking attacks (a boss can and will jump into the air, stay there for 3 sec and track you like the fricking FBI) - and he will then charge you with an instand attack



- Absolute pointless puzzle items and BS positioning of those (You need a lion head key for the lion head door ... walk 10 meter ... lion head key! - Now walk 10 meters back and open the door) -(!!! That happend in 7h like 5 times already FTW!!!)



- Pointless invisible Walls everywhere (Look a leader/door/way out of the fight - blocked by invisible wall)



- The music is just bad. I turned it of after 5h, because is so .... annoying... aggressively so.



- Random detection of parries and dodges (sometimes the game just said no.)



If you want dark souls. Just no.



If you want Devil may cry. Also no.



If you want more of the worst black myth wukong. You kinda get that here, but i dont know why you would want that.



PS: I beat that "Monk" boss after nearly 2 hours of bs. The only thing i can think of now is the de-install button



PSS: I found a tree with a face. That thing should give me my abilities back. .... ......... That is just an arena with as much enemies as possible and then 3 bosses. 



Thats it .. de-install and never touching this SH*T again.
